reason: Conversation 2 immediately and correctly explained 22E as a fridge evaporator-fan error likely caused by ice, gave a safe unplugged manual defrost with explicit warnings against sharp tools, clearly separated an ice-jam from a failed motor, warned against buying a fan on the code alone, addressed warranty and food safety, and set a sensible escalation path if the code recurs.
